title: AI policy and health leak across account reload
verification: P0; Confirmed framework behavior; focused local verification
root_cause: Retained Riverpod dependency values and startup reconciliation were not both gated on the current owner policy and health epoch.
regression_test: Delayed A-to-B policy/health load exposes zero capabilities and performs zero startup-reconciliation reads.
fix_summary: Current-scope settings and health must both be ready and safe before policy use or reconciliation.

title: In-flight financial tool reads current user's scope
verification: P0; High confidence; focused owner/egress spies
root_cause: Tool requests formerly re-resolved mutable current-owner providers after awaits instead of carrying an immutable owner/session binding.
regression_test: Delayed A-to-B and logout races produce zero B repository reads, zero stale provider bytes, and no late UI state.
fix_summary: Bind scope and Auth generation to the request, capture owner-scoped dependencies before the first await, and revalidate before/after every await and egress.
test_result: Group 1 focused suite: 76/76 passed; real Firebase/Groq switching not executed.

title: Receipt capture has owner-switch TOCTOU
verification: P0; High confidence; focused lease/provider tests
root_cause: Receipt capture formerly re-read current providers across asynchronous image, persistence, and analysis stages.
regression_test: Switch/logout at import, store, upload, and response boundaries retains no A bytes/draft and persists no result into B.
fix_summary: Capture an immutable receipt owner/session/repository/consent lease, checkpoint every await, cancel late work, and purge transient bytes/state.
test_result: Group 1 focused suite: 76/76 passed; real device/Firebase receipt flow not executed.

title: Auth-switch deletion TOCTOU
verification: P0; High confidence; deterministic local race coverage
root_cause: Deletion formerly re-resolved FirebaseAuth.currentUser across stages.
regression_test: A-to-B switch, logout, same-UID relogin, and tampered confirmation lease never delete a replacement user.
fix_summary: Use one immutable operation context containing operation ID, original UID, owner scope, Auth generation, and stage; revalidate it at every boundary and delete Auth last.
test_result: Final deletion suite: 101/101 passed; staging Auth interleaving not executed.

title: Sync can resurrect data after full deletion
verification: P0; High confidence; local/gateway/emulator verification
root_cause: There was no durable owner write quarantine and drain spanning sync, AI, receipt, cloud deletion, and restart.
regression_test: Delayed writers drain before deletion; permanent lock blocks later writes; restart removes A while preserving B.
fix_summary: Durably quarantine the owner, drain scoped writers, install a permanent server lock, recursively delete and verify cloud data, delete local data/files, then delete Auth.
test_result: Deletion 101/101; deletion/sync fence 119/119; gateway 109/109; synthetic Auth/Admin emulator 2/2. Deployed two-device test not executed.

title: Deletion trusts caller identity flags
verification: P0; Confirmed; production-datasource tamper matrix
root_cause: Caller identity fields and missing confirmation-lease fields could be treated as authority or wildcards.
regression_test: Altered or removed anonymous status, owner scope, or Auth generation fails before cloud, local, Auth, token, or state mutation.
fix_summary: Derive identity only from trusted Auth, retain the exact issued lease, require every field to match exactly, and reject null scope/generation.
test_result: Final deletion suite: 101/101 passed; five lease-tamper cases pass with zero mutation.

title: Legacy Auth controller bypasses full deletion
verification: Necessary P1 companion; Confirmed architecture check
root_cause: A duplicate public Auth-only deletion path bypassed the ordered authoritative pipeline.
regression_test: Every public deletion entry reaches the single ordered pipeline; no legacy deleteAccount symbol remains in auth.
fix_summary: Remove the legacy Auth-only API/use case and route every entry through the resumable deletion coordinator.
test_result: Final deletion suite: 101/101 passed; device entry-point verification not executed.

title: Opening balance bypasses the ledger
verification: P0; Confirmed; deterministic SQLite verification
root_cause: A nonzero account DTO was inserted directly without an auditable ledger event or atomic rollback.
regression_test: Create 100 produces a zero-first account plus one posted opening transaction; replay is exact-once; failure rolls back both.
fix_summary: Create the account at zero and post one deterministic opening transaction through the Finance Engine in one database transaction; block raw nonzero inserts.

title: Account update can rewrite balance and currency
verification: P0; Confirmed; malicious caller and raw-SQL verification
root_cause: The repository accepted a whole account DTO and did not reject protected-field mutation attempts.
regression_test: A malicious balance/currency/type/createdAt rewrite returns account_protected_field_mutation and preserves the row atomically.
fix_summary: Expose metadata-only persistence, reject any protected-field delta with a typed failure, and retain persistent database guards.

title: Cross-currency transfer accepts inconsistent amount and rate
verification: P0; Confirmed; exact Decimal matrix
root_cause: Source amount, target amount, rate, and direction were independently trusted.
regression_test: Consistent, inconsistent, high-precision, negative/zero rate, reversed direction, pending, preview, reverse, and no-mutation rejection cases.
fix_summary: Validate exact Decimal target=source*rate and direction before any preview, write, balance effect, or reversal.

title: Reused transfer group duplicates balance effects
verification: P0; Confirmed; concurrent/restart/file-database verification
root_cause: transferGroupId was not an owner-bound payload idempotency key and pair shape was not persistently enforced.
regression_test: Double confirmation, exact retry, concurrent retry, restart, between-leg failure, cross-owner collision, third leg, one-leg status/delete, same-account, and malformed legacy group.
fix_summary: Bind an owner/group fingerprint to exactly one source and destination leg, use guarded atomic pair capabilities, return exact replay, and quarantine malformed legacy state.

title: Transfer-group owner guard missing on update
verification: Necessary P1 companion; Confirmed persistent guard
root_cause: Transfer-group owner isolation existed on INSERT but not UPDATE/legacy claim.
regression_test: Cross-owner transfer_group_id update aborts atomically; same-owner update and valid sequential legacy claim pass.
fix_summary: Add the matching UPDATE trigger and owner-scoped legacy-claim guard.
test_result: 3/3 focused tests passed within the 187-test group run.

title: Negative opening balance creates unrecoverable account state
verification: Necessary P1 companion; Confirmed Finance policy boundary
root_cause: Negative opening balances conflicted with a no-negative balance policy and could not be repaired.
regression_test: All persisted account types reject negative opening; positive credit may repair a legacy negative row while further debit remains blocked.
fix_summary: Reject negative openings before account creation and validate the next balance so a repairing credit is allowed.
test_result: Covered by Groups 3-4 focused suites: 187/187 passed.

title: Financial grounding accepts unsupported numeric forms
verification: Necessary P1 companion; Confirmed gateway runtime tests
root_cause: JavaScript Number canonicalization and incomplete lexical parsing lost exactness and missed Arabic/scientific forms.
regression_test: Arabic/Persian/ASCII values, grouping, separators, signs, percentages, >2^53, dimensions, dates, scientific notation, and correction exhaustion.
fix_summary: Use exact lexical decimal/date/count parsing with producer/field dimension provenance; emit no text before successful validation.

title: Client lacks numeric grounding validation
verification: Necessary P1 companion; Confirmed client source and focused tests
root_cause: Flutter could choose provider prose verbatim without tracing each number to typed local facts.
regression_test: Fabricated Arabic/English values, wrong currency/period/category/dimension/provenance, exponent and >2^53 cases reject; exact facts pass.
fix_summary: Build a typed local fact registry, compare Decimal/date claims exactly, and fall back to deterministic local composition on any unsupported claim.

title: False execution claims pass gateway-wide
verification: Necessary P1 companion; Confirmed gateway runtime tests
root_cause: A narrow route-specific phrase regex allowed passive, Arabic, split-stream, general, and clarification success claims.
regression_test: Arabic/English/Libyan active, passive, indirect, chunked, general, financial, and clarification claims reject; non-execution advice passes.
fix_summary: Apply one central claim policy to all routes and buffer provider output until whole-response validation.

title: Client lacks false-mutation-claim validation
verification: Necessary P1 companion; Confirmed client source and focused tests
root_cause: Provider text had no centralized client-side execution-claim policy and streamed before complete validation.
regression_test: Provider text cannot prove success before confirmation, after local failure, or for another owner; Arabic/English claims and split streams reject.
fix_summary: Guard every client composition path, buffer provider snapshots, and permit success UI only from locally verified durable execution state.

title: Reconciliation verifies incomplete business state
verification: Necessary P1 companion; Confirmed exact-state tests
root_cause: A partial receipt/business-row comparison could label an inconsistent or foreign operation as verified success.
regression_test: Operation keys bind owner scope, command, revision, and action; every persisted field mismatch remains uncertain; missing row never succeeds.
fix_summary: Require exact immediate reconciliation of the full deterministic operation spec before local UI success.

title: Financial context schema forwards arbitrary private fields
verification: Necessary P1 companion; Confirmed client/server contract spies
root_cause: Generic financial records and shared history allowed arbitrary fields and excess context toward Groq.
regression_test: Unknown tools/keys, UID/owner/token/database/file/confirmation/history fields, payee/note/receipt injection, oversized lists, and numeric money reject or are omitted.
fix_summary: Use exact per-tool allowlists on Flutter and gateway, sanitize labels as data, bound records, and send only the current message for financial/tool-selection requests.
test_result: Group 5 Flutter 66/66 and gateway 109/109 passed; lint/typecheck/build/secret-scan passed.

title: Generic financial concepts route to personal analysis
verification: Necessary P1 companion; Confirmed routing tests
root_cause: Broad topic matching treated educational finance questions as permission to read private financial data.
regression_test: Generic concept corpus performs zero private reads/tools; explicit personal-spending questions remain personal.
fix_summary: Require an explicit personal-data signal before personalFinancialAnalysis; default concepts to general conversation.
